goal: REAL conveyor FEEDER: belt-motion (proven) + an end-stop so a riding cube ARRIVES at a fixed pick-zone (stays on the belt at x~0) instead of falling off the end. The composable feeder primitive for a downstream pick cell.
thoughts: Adds a static end-stop wall at the belt downstream end to CP-CONV-01. Verify via scene_eyes: the cube rides +x and STOPS at the wall ON the belt (z stays ~1.78, not 0.78=fell to table).
code:
# CP-CONV-01b: REAL conveyor FEEDER — belt motion (CP-CONV-01, proven) + an END-STOP so a riding cube ARRIVES
# at a fixed pick-zone instead of falling off the belt end. This is the composable feeder primitive: a real
# conveyor presents an object at a reachable, fixed position for a downstream pick cell. cont.319v.
create_scene_baseline(include_ground=True, table_size=[2.0, 1.0])

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Conveyor", prim_type="Xform", position=[0, 0, 0])
add_reference(prim_path="/World/Conveyor", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Isaac/Props/Conveyors/ConveyorBelt_A09.usd")

# 3-API surface-velocity retrofit on the belt (proven in CP-CONV-01). +x local 0.20 m/s.
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physics:kinematicEnabled", value=True)
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysxSurfaceVelocityAPI")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physxSurfaceVelocity:surfaceVelocity", value=[0.2, 0.0, 0.0])
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physxSurfaceVelocity:surfaceVelocityEnabled", value=True)
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physxSurfaceVelocity:surfaceVelocityLocalSpace", value=True)

# END-STOP wall just past the belt downstream end (belt ends at x=-0.002). Static collider: 0.02m thick, 0.9m
# wide (belt width), 0.1m tall straddling the belt top (1.781) -> blocks the cube so it stays ON the belt at the
# pick-zone instead of falling off. The belt keeps pushing the cube against the wall = a held presentation pose.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/EndStop", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.03, 0.0, 1.82], scale=[0.01, 0.45, 0.05])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/EndStop", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# ONE 5cm cube spawned upstream on the belt -> rides +x to the end-stop and arrives at the pick-zone (x ~ 0).
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[-1.8, 0.0, 1.810], scale=[0.025, 0.025, 0.025])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
verified_note: scene_eyes 40s: Cube_1 starts on /World/Conveyor/Belt (t=0), RIDES +x and contacts /World/EndStop at t=8.3s (x=-1.8 -> ~0, ~1.8m at 0.2 m/s), SETTLED-Z=1.804 (STAYS on the belt at pick-zone, NOT 0.78=fell-to-table like CP-CONV-01's unguarded end), upright 0.0deg tilt. The real conveyor presents an object at a fixed, reachable, upright pick-zone = the composable feeder primitive.
extension_notes: Feeder primitive PROVEN. CP-CONV-02 adds a pedestal Franka (reach_validate-grounded base height ~1.4-1.5m for a natural down-reach onto the 1.781m belt) to pick from this pick-zone into a bin -> complete real-conveyor pick cell.
